devon: Ran dry-run eviction simulation across two regions (IAD + SFO) for reserve-pool reclaim and spot-eviction scenarios. Posting quick notes — we should update the failover runbook.
alex: Nice. TL;DR on biggest surprise?
devon: 1) Warm-pool failed to cold-start VMs in SFO within 4m target (we saw 7–9m). 2) Traffic-shift hooks caused transient 5% route churn; no errors but latency spike. 3) Eviction script deadlock when multiple pods selected same node -> queue drain hung.
sarah: Cost note: autoscaler bumped instances early; projected +12% spend for the hour in simulation. Need cooldown gating.
maria: @devon can you paste the drain command we used?
devon: Sure:
```bash
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --force --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 node/$NODE
```
We also tried a patched version with --pod-selector to limit parallel drains.
jay: Drain deadlock root cause looks like concurrent drain without backoff. Proposal: serialized node-drain with jitter + max-parallel=3. I'll add psuedo patch.
jay: Pseudo:
```py
for n in nodes:
  sleep(random.uniform(0.5,2.0))
  drain(n)
  wait_for_pods_cleared(timeout=300)
```
ops-bot: dry-run:eviction-sim completed by devon at 2026-03-15T21:10:53Z :white_check_mark:
devon: Runbook changes I want to add:
- Adjust warm-pool ASG healthcheck -> reduce scale-in cooldown from 10m to 3m for prewarmed nodes.
- Add serialized drain algorithm and sample code snippet.
- Add cost guardrail: autoscaler should not exceed +8% hourly budget without approval.
- Add traffic-shift circuit-breaker: if 3 consecutive latency spikes > p95 threshold, rollback.
alex: We should also add a preflight checklist for capacity drills: verify AMI boot times, control-plane api-server latency, and egress path TTLs.
sarah: Also add a metric-driven alert for 'warm-pool-warmup-duration' and link to billing estimate automation.
maria: What about rollback time SLO? we need target for full recovery.
devon: Goal: full reroute + warm-pool restore within 12m. Current sim median was 9m, but tail was 21m; patch needed.
jay: I'll open a PR for serialized drain + unit tests. tagging @sarah for cost guardrail wording.
sarah: :thumbsup: please include example budget config and SLA impact note.
devon: Action items:
- jay -> PR for drain algorithm + test (due 2d)
- alex -> update playbook preflight checklist (due 3d)
- sarah -> draft cost guardrail wording + alert link (due 3d)
- maria -> add target SLOs and recovery steps (due 2d)
- devon -> update runbook doc with code snippets + deploy dry-run next week

Will sync in infra sync tomorrow. Thanks!
